title: Singapore Public Housing — Core Overview (Edition 1)
description: Singapore's Housing and Development Board houses the large majority of residents in publicly built flats. Ethnic integration quotas in each block prevent segregation. This overview edition presents Singapore Public Housing as a core housing concept for contemporary cities.

principles: Add supply at many price points
Locate homes near jobs and transit

real_examples.fact: Roughly four in five Singaporeans live in HDB flats.

spec.source_note: Core facts verified from public sources.
